reviewed_by: Codex focused review for ordered native Browser presentation
reason: The changed journey is opening and switching native Browser tabs while the Browser slot moves. The two selected component files cover asynchronous presentation ordering, the hide-before-show barrier, and Workbench Browser create, hide, restore, placement failure, and retry behavior. Three exact Rust cases cover bounds validation and macOS frame math; macOS CI compiles the native presentation command. The selected Browser catalog entries cover desktop mocked native placement and emulated mobile Chromium/WebKit fallback layouts.
exclusions: No Python or Core browser engine state changed, so Python tests and real-Core Playwright are excluded. LAN-origin behavior is unchanged. The desktop Playwright Tauri mock and Linux Rust tests cannot prove macOS WKWebView compositing; a rebuilt Mac app visual and input check is required before claiming native containment. Physical mobile devices are unavailable; selected mobile browser projects are emulated. Unrelated suites are excluded.
